comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Found it. This is from the JP server, so contents may differ slightly on GAMA, but...

Smoke Bomb x5
Sun-faded Old Map x5 -- Sun-faded Old Map (consumable; Complete all essential tasks of the current active sea or land region investigation and increase the completion rate. Use after taking new investigations.)
Amethyst ring
Galileo-style Telescope
Naturalist's Hints on Collection x5 -- "Knowledge of the collection of naturalists" (consumable; Collection effect, skill level rank unknown)
Custom Salvage Rope x5
Escape Rope x5
Memo of Skill Use x5 -- "Memorandum of utilization of skills (no trade)" (four skills usable at sea?)
Court Gardener Permit

Forgive the quote marks, but I don't know all of the item names offhand. Once again, the chest's contents on GAMA may have been altered, so the only way to truly know, will be to collect and open these chests, then share the drops here. Hope this list helps some in the mean time. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Colosseum
